scope: synthetic local processes only; no model or network

posix.ownership: separate supervisor process group and parent-only liveness writer
posix.status: original child exit code and signal on a private bounded status pipe
posix.limit: deliberate setsid/process-group escape and supervisor SIGKILL/OOM are outside containment; not a sandbox
posix.cwd: verify open dot directory identity; target inherits cwd without a second chdir

windows.ownership: KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE job assigned atomically by PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_JOB_LIST at process creation
windows.start: resume only after successful atomic creation in job

environment.proxyAndCa: absent by default; local-owner overrides only, never logged or shared
environment.sshAuthSock: absent by default; local-owner override delegates signing authority
environment.shellImport: never implicit; local-owner opt-in required before executing startup scripts

admission.source: live owned-process registry, never durable session state or test counters
admission.whenIdleM1_3: wait for all owned processes to exit
admission.busyIdleSemantics: M1-8, after real adapter observations exist
